adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the table is created with only columns and no indexes/constraints. Yet lookups in app/models/embeddable_host.rb use `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, which will be on the hot path for embedding (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`). Without an index (ideally on `lower(host)` or a normalized `host` with a unique index), this becomes a full table scan and there is no protection against duplicates being inserted (migration inserts rows directly via SQL and there’s no uniqueness validation shown). This is a concrete, diff-grounded integrity/performance concern, but not an immediate functional break proven by the diff alone.
